mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) combined with eplerenone (potassium-sparing diuretic) increases risk of hyperkalemia and hypertensive crisis due to sympathomimetic potentiation and reduced potassium excretion.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, monitor serum potassium and blood pressure closely, ensure adequate dietary potassium restriction, and consider alternative antidepressant or diuretic therapy.
